probabilityFloorNote: A band's footprint is cut at this burn probability. With 10 members it means at least 2 of 10 runs burned that ground by that hour. Also the threshold for the conservative arrival time.

scoring.$comment: Talaia already computes a life-safety-weighted priority_score. ARCA orders by spare time first and uses that score only to break ties.
